tasks.title: Cut over Event runtime to 2.0 and purge pre-launch Event instances
acceptance: Composition 2.0.0 is the only accepted Event runtime contract; Event 1.x requests fail with event.schema.unsupported and retired routes return 404.

The explicit preview/apply/verify reset preserves templates, policies, venue resources and non-Event data while deleting only Event instances and scoped records under a target-bound fingerprint; production irreversible mode rejects exclusive remote-file candidates.

The local reset retains its verified-backup and repeat no-op evidence; the separately authorised production operation uses the exact --Events:NoRecovery=true argument without SQL/R2 recovery copies or rollback, and records irreversible mode in its fingerprint and receipt.

Production Event writes are frozen and drained for the exact target; the three Event-only Durable Object namespaces are inventoried, any stored data is cleared and verified empty, and stale clients are isolated by the new Event data epoch without logging object IDs. Ordinary Worker version uploads remain free of lifecycle migrations.

Production apply uses a reviewed live preview fingerprint, exact target/schema/code/freeze identity, serializable transaction and count checks; post-operation verification proves zero Event-scoped rows/references and unchanged templates, policies, venue resources and non-Event data.

Normal migration, seed, application startup and deployment cannot invoke the reset or recreate a demo Event; ordinary API deployment fails when the Event 2.0 storage migration is pending and requires an existing current Event data epoch and explicit write mode.
